title: Multi-objective Hyperparameter Optimization with Expert Priors
abstract: arXiv:2511.08371v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: While Deep Learning (DL) experts often have prior knowledge about which hyperparameter settings yield strong performance, only few Hyperparameter Optimization (HPO) algorithms can leverage such prior knowledge and none incorporate priors over multiple objectives. As DL practitioners often need to optimize not just one but many objectives, this is a blind spot in the algorithmic landscape of HPO. To address this shortcoming, we propose the novel problem setting of multi-objective HPO with expert priors and introduce PriMO, the first HPO algorithm that can integrate user beliefs over multiple objectives. We show PriMO achieves state-of-the-art performance across 8 DL benchmarks in the multi-objective and single-objective setting. Further, we demonstrate that PriMO remains state-of-the-art at large scales by optimizing a vision-language model over three objectives.

translated_title: 基于专家先验的多目标超参数优化
translated_abstract: 尽管深度学习（DL）专家通常对哪些超参数设置能带来优异性能拥有先验知识，但只有少数超参数优化（HPO）算法能够利用这类先验知识，且没有任何算法能将先验知识融入多目标优化。由于深度学习从业者往往需要优化的目标不止一个而是多个，这构成了HPO算法领域的一个盲区。为弥补这一不足，我们提出了带专家先验的多目标HPO这一全新问题设定，并引入PriMO——首个能够在多个目标上整合用户信念的HPO算法。我们证明PriMO在8个深度学习基准上于多目标和单目标设定下均取得了最先进的性能。此外，我们通过在三个目标上优化一个视觉-语言模型，展示了PriMO在大规模场景下依然保持最先进水平。
tldr: 提出首个能将专家先验知识融入多目标超参数优化的算法PriMO，在8个深度学习基准以及大规模视觉-语言模型的多目标优化中均达到最先进性能。
en_tdlr: Proposes PriMO, the first HPO algorithm that integrates expert priors over multiple objectives, achieving state-of-the-art performance across 8 deep learning benchmarks and in large-scale multi-objective optimization of a vision-language model.
